sections.content: DON’T MISS OUT Who is a maritime neighbour?

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: A maritime neighbour is a country connected to another by a shared sea or ocean, even without a direct land border. (Revisit the chapter ‘Oceans and Continents’ in your Grade 6 textbook.) The ocean acts as a vital link, facilitating centuries of trade, cultural exchange, and historical ties.
